---
title: "Tags"
toc: false
listing:
  id: tagged-notes
  contents: "**/*.qmd"
  include:
    categories: "*"
  exclude:
    categories: [appendix, atomization, math1964, math1972]
  type: table
  fields: [title, categories]
  field-display-names:
    title: Note
    categories: Tags
  categories: true
  sort: "title asc"
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
---

Choose a tag to see notes on that topic.

::: {#tag-filters role="group" aria-label="Filter notes by tag"}
:::

::: {#tagged-notes}
:::

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const filters = document.querySelector("#quarto-margin-sidebar .quarto-listing-category");
  if (!filters) return;
  document.getElementById("tag-filters").append(filters);

  for (const link of document.querySelectorAll("#listing-tagged-notes a.listing-title")) {
    link.classList.add("no-external");
  }

  for (const category of filters.children) {
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.append(...category.childNodes);
    category.append(button);
  }

  function updateSelection() {
    const selected = filters.querySelector(".category.active") ?? filters.firstElementChild;
    for (const category of filters.children) {
      category.firstElementChild.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(category === selected));
    }
  }

  new MutationObserver(updateSelection).observe(filters, {
    subtree: true,
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ["class"],
  });
  updateSelection();

  // Quarto reapplies named filters on history navigation. Reset the All view too.
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => {
    if (!new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1)).get("category")) activateCategory("");
  });
});
</script>
